descriptions.url_length: Total character length of the normalized URL
descriptions.registered_domain_length: Character length of the registered domain
descriptions.query_length: Length of the query string parameters
descriptions.count_dots: Number of dot characters (.) in the URL
descriptions.count_hyphens: Number of hyphen characters (-) in the URL
descriptions.count_underscores: Number of underscore characters (_) in the URL
descriptions.count_slashes: Number of forward slashes (/) in the URL
descriptions.count_equals: Number of equal signs (=) in parameters
descriptions.count_percent: Number of percent characters (%) indicating URL encoding
descriptions.count_digits: Total count of numeric digit characters in URL
descriptions.digit_ratio: Proportion of numeric digits to total URL length
descriptions.subdomain_depth: Depth of subdomains preceding registered domain
descriptions.has_ip_hostname: Flag indicating if hostname is a raw IPv4/IPv6 address
descriptions.has_at_symbol: Flag indicating presence of credentials delimiter (@)
descriptions.has_fragment: Flag indicating presence of anchor fragment (#)
descriptions.has_encoded_chars: Flag indicating presence of hex-encoded characters
descriptions.has_suspicious_words_hostname: Flag indicating deceptive security terms in hostname
descriptions.suspicious_words_count: Frequency of deceptive security terms in hostname
descriptions.has_brand_in_subdomain: Flag indicating known brand token found in subdomain
descriptions.brand_in_subdomain_count: Count of popular brand tokens in subdomain
descriptions.hostname_entropy: Shannon entropy score of the hostname character distribution
descriptions.path_entropy: Shannon entropy score of the URL path character distribution
descriptions.page_features_available: Flag indicating whether webpage HTML was retrieved and analyzed
descriptions.title_length: Character length of the HTML document title
descriptions.text_length: Character length of sanitized visible text
descriptions.num_forms: Total number of interactive HTML forms
descriptions.num_password_inputs: Count of sensitive password input fields
descriptions.num_external_links: Count of hyperlinks pointing to external domains
descriptions.num_internal_links: Count of hyperlinks pointing within the same domain
descriptions.num_scripts: Count of client-side JavaScript script tags
descriptions.has_login_form: Indicator of login or credential entry form
descriptions.num_hidden_inputs: Count of hidden form input fields
descriptions.external_resource_ratio: Proportion of external links to total links
descriptions.has_external_form_action: High-risk flag: form action posts to a foreign domain
descriptions.login_keyword_freq: Occurrences of login/sign-in keywords in visible text
descriptions.financial_keyword_freq: Occurrences of payment, banking, or credit card keywords
descriptions.urgency_keyword_freq: Occurrences of artificial urgency phrases (e.g. within 24 hours)
descriptions.brand_impersonation_count: Count of brand names in text not matching registered domain
descriptions.title_domain_mismatch: High-risk indicator: page title claims a brand foreign to domain
